name: Chicken Breast with Pizza Sauce Linguine
description: A quick and easy meal combining tender chicken breast with the flavor of pizza sauce and al dente linguine.
fun_fact: This dish brings together the classic flavors of pizza in a pasta form, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add enough olive oil to coat the bottom of the pan.
Place the chicken breasts in the skillet and cook for about 6-7 minutes per side, or until fully cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the linguine according to package instructions until al dente.
Drain the linguine and add it to the skillet with the cooked chicken. Pour in the pizza sauce and stir well to coat the pasta and chicken evenly.
Let everything simmer for about 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has slightly thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil leaves.
